hero.title: Contextual Education
hero.description: Empowering Papua's next generation through joyful learning.

background.title: Every Papuan Child Can Shine
background.content: Children learn through play at Paradise Nature School, developing character, language, and skills aligned with their interests and passions. Every learning experience is designed to be contextual, joyful, and rooted in everyday life.

activity.title: Main Activity
activity.description: Learning takes place at Paradise Nature School (SAP) in Merauke, Paradise Nature School Ambonggo (SAPA) in Boven Digoel, and PKBM Paradise. We focus on character building, English, local languages, math, knitting, football, nurturing each child's talents based on their unique interests. Every lesson is contextual, engaging, and connected to real life.

benefits.subtitle: Inspiring positive change in their lives

items.title: Growing Confident in Language Skill
items.description: Through English and local language learning, children express themselves boldly and appreciate the cultural diversity around them.

items.title: Learning That's Relevant to Life
items.description: Children understand lessons through things they encounter dailymaking learning feel close, real, and meaningful.

items.title: Developing Talents & Creativity
items.description: Each child gets space to explore their interests from knitting,sports, and arts to building pride and responsibility for their potential.

items.title: Learning Life Values & Character
items.description: Learning goes beyond knowledge, it shapes attitude, empathy, and collaboration as tools for facing the future.

hero.title: Grassroot Economy
hero.description: Empowering local Papuan communities to be productive.

background.title: Advancing Papua's Economy for a Better Life
background.content: We support local communities in developing creative products rooted in their culture and ancestral heritage, from noken to virgin coconut oil and traditional snacks. With our guidance, their enterprises grow while preserving local identity and indigenous wisdom.

activity.title: Main Activity
activity.description: We work alongside community groups driving culture-based local economies. The Yekinto group in Yanggandur Village creates cultural artifacts to preserve ancestral heritage. The Yu Mbu Tar Ta group in Onggaya Village produces VCO, shrimp paste, shredded meat, chips, and traditional ornaments as tradition-based entrepreneurship. The Katin Sai group in Gudang Arang, Merauke, consists of women noken weavers strengthening family economies through their craft and dedication.

benefits.title: The Benefits They Experience
benefits.subtitle: Inspiring positive change in their lives

items.title: Local Economic Independence
items.description: Communities learn to manage natural and cultural resources around them to create sustainable income sources.

items.title: Preserving Heritage & Culture
items.description: Through products like noken and cultural artifacts, generations-old traditions stay alive and pass down to the youth.

items.title: Community Collaboration & Solidarity
items.description: Each group grows through cooperation, mutual support, and knowledge sharing among community members.

hero.title: Indigenous Forests and Environment
hero.description: Supporting indigenous communities to protect forests and revitalize their environment.

background.title: Protecting Nature, Protecting Our Home in Papua
background.content: We work alongside indigenous communities to map forest territories, protect ecosystems, and transform plastic waste into EcoBricks for furniture. We also plant mangroves and organize clean-ups to keep the environment thriving.

activity.title: Main Activity
activity.description: We help indigenous communities safeguard their ancestral forests through territorial mapping with two tribes, the Kanum and Marori, to preserve their lands. We also process plastic bottle waste into EcoBricks (plastic bricks) that are collected and transformed into chairs, tables, and more. We regularly organize waste clean-up campaigns and plant mangroves in critical areas prone to flooding around Gudang Arang, Merauke, South Papua.

benefits.title: The Benefits They Experience
benefits.subtitle: Inspiring positive change in their lives

items.title: Protected Indigenous Forests
items.description: Indigenous communities gain deeper understanding of their territorial boundaries and value through forest mapping, enabling them to protect and manage natural resources sustainably.

items.title: Cleaner & Healthier Environment
items.description: hrough recycling plastic bottles into EcoBricks, village clean-up drives, and mangrove planting, the surrounding environment becomes more organized and waste-free.

items.title: Growing Ecological Awareness
items.description: Communities begin to see that protecting forests and the environment is not just a duty, but an investment in their own future.
